[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:1)


**לכן. הנני יסד.** שם התאר מהבנין הכבד על משקל אבד והנה כמוהו יוצא, ושבח אני את המתים (קהלת ד' ב'):


הנני יִסַּד *I will lay the foundation*. יסד is an adjective,¹⁹ derived from a Piel like אִבַּד he hath destroyed (Lam. 2:9).²⁰ Comp. ושבח אני and I praise (Koh. 4:2); which is likewise transitive.

footnotes:
¹⁹ יסד and שבח, according to I. E., may also be considered as participles of the Piël, the preformative מְ of the Piël and Pual being sometimes dropped.
²⁰ The Piël past has two forms, פִּעְל and פִּעַל; it is with the latter that יִסַּד is compared, and therefore אִבַּד is quoted. Comp. Zahoth, On the Piël.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:2)


**אבן בחן.** כמו עופל ובוחן (ישעיהו ל"ד י"ד), והטעם שתהיה נשגבה ציון ממלך אשור:


בחן *Tower*.²¹ Comp. ובוחן and towers (32:14). Zion will be protected against the King of Assyria.

footnotes:
²¹ A. V., Tried.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:3)


**פנת יקרת מוסד.** הראשון שם כמו היסוד, ויקרת סמוך אליו, ומוסד השני פעול מבנין הכבד הנוסף על משקל מוצב ארצה, על כן הסמ"ך דגוש לבלוע הכפל:


מוסד מוסד *A sure foundation*. The first מוסד is a noun, meaning foundation; it is a genitive, governed by the preceding noun יקרת the value of; the second is a participle Hophal, like מוסב; the ס has therefore a Dagesh, as a substitute for the omitted silent letter (ו).²²

footnotes:
²² The Hebrew text has לבלוע הכפל to compensate for the omission of the duplicate; this does not refer to the ד, since the root is not סדד, but to the omission of ו, which is also noticed by the Masora; there should be two ו, one the mater lectionis, the other the first letter of the root. Comp. Zahoth, On the Hiphil.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:16:4)


**מאמין לא יחיש.** כי עוד לימים רבים תהיה זאת הנבואה:


*Shall not make haste.* For this prophecy refers to a very remote future.



### Verse 17

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:1)


**ושמתי.** דרך משל על קו ומשקלת הבונים, בעבור שאמר הנני יסד בציון אבן, ויש אומרים כי האבן על דרך משל על חזקיהו:


*To the line, to the plummet.* The figure, taken from the line and plummet of the builders, is used because of the words I will lay the foundation. Some are of opinion that Hezekiah is meant by the tried stone.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:2)


**ויעה ברד.** מגזרת היעים, והנה ברד פועל, כי יעה פועל יוצא, וטעם ברד משל למלך אשור:


ויעה ברד *And the hail shall sweep away.* Comp. היעים the shovels. ברד the hail is the subject to יעה, which is a transitive verb;²³ by hail the King of Assyria is here meant.

footnotes:
²³ What I. E. means by this additional remark, that יעה is transitive is not clear; it can hardly be otherwise.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:17:3)


**מחסה.** מושך אחר וכן הוא וסתר מחסה מים ישטופו, או תחסר מלת אלה:


וסתר מים ישטפו. Repeat כזב falsehood after וסתר; And the waters shall overflow the hiding-place of falsehood; or supply אלה these: And the waters will overflow the unstable hiding-place.²⁴

footnotes:
²⁴ In the Hebrew text the words וכן הוא וסתר מחסה מים ישטפו are without sense; there is no occasion whatever for the addition of מחסה, since מחסה וסתר is nearly the same as וסתר. But comparing this verse with ver. 15, we find that the word next to מחסה, namely כזב, is probably to be repeated. In the second explanation סתר מים, the hiding-place of water, סתר כזב ═, the hiding-place of falsehood, ═ the false or unstable hiding-place; and the literal translation of the whole phrase is: and the hiding-place of waters, these (the waters) will overflow. This latter interpretation is supported by the accents which join מים with סתר.



### Verse 18

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:1)


**וכפר.** כמו ואיש חכם יכפרנה (משלי ט"ז י"ד) כטעם השחתה והסרה:


וכפר *And shall be disannulled.* Comp. יכפרנה he will pacify it, that is, will annul or remove it. וברית חזותכם═וחזותכם And your prophetical agreement.²⁵

footnotes:
²⁵ A. V., And your agreement.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:2)


**[וחזותכם את שאול].** וברית חזותכם עם שאול:


והייתם *Then you shall be.*


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:18:3)


וי"ו**והייתם**כפ"א רפה בלשון ישמעאל, וכמוהו ביום השלישי וישא אברהם את עיניו (בראשית כ"ב ד'):


The ו has the same force as فَ in Arabic;²⁶ comp. וישא ביום השלישי on the third day, then Abraham lifted up (Gen. 22:4)

footnotes:
²⁶ To introduce the apodosis when the protasis precedes; the phrase השלשי ביום is treated as the full sentence ויהי ביום השלשי When the third day came.



### Verse 19

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:19:1)


**מדי.** עבור הנחל השוטף יקחכם:


*That it goeth forth.* That the overflowing river²⁷ goeth forth.

footnotes:
²⁷ The overflowing scourge of the preceding verse.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:19:2)


**זועה.** איננו כמו זעוה (דברים כ"ח כ"ה) הפוך כאשר יפרישו רבי', רק הוא מגזרת ולא זע ממנו (אסתר ה' ט') ובא הוי"ו באמצע כוי"ו מות, והטעם כי יפחד מי שיבין שמועתכם מה שירע [צ"ל שאירע] לכם:


זועה *Vexation.* It is not the same as זעוה (Deut. 28:25), with transposition of letters, as many²⁸ think; but it is derived from זוע to tremble, to move; comp. ולא זע and he moved not (Est. 5:9); the ו in the middle is analogous to the ו of מָוֶת death. The meaning of the whole phrase is: Whoever hears of you, of what has befallen you, will be afraid.

footnotes:
²⁸ Among them I. E. himself in his commentary on Deut. 28:25.



### Verse 20

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:1)


**כי. המצע.** שהוא למטה ביציע:


המצע *The mattress*,²⁹ which is underneath in the bed.

footnotes:
²⁹ A. V., The bed.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:2)


**מהשתרע.** מהתפרש והמשך המסך כמו ושרוע וקלוט (ויקרא כ"ב כ"ג):


מהשתרע *than that a man can stretch himself on it.* Comp. שרוע superfluous too long (Lev. 22:23).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:3)


**והמסכה.** כמו מכסה:


המכסה═המסכה *The covering.*


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:20:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:20:4)


**כהתכנס.** שם הפועל מגזרת לך כנוס (אסתר ד' ט"ז), וטעם כהתכנס כאשר יתחברו תחתיה רבים, וזה דרך משל על העם והמושלים בם:


בהתכנס It is Infinitive of כנס to assemble; comp. כנוס gather together (Est. 4:16); and means When many gather together under it.³⁰ The figure refers to the people and its rulers.³¹

footnotes:
³⁰ A. V., Than that he can wrap himself in it.
³¹ Both the people and its rulers fail to give each other comfort and protection.



### Verse 21

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:1)


**כי כהר פרצים.** הוא הנודע במלחמות דוד (שמואל ב' ה' כ') שנקרא בעל פרצים כי בפתע פתאום רוצחו הפלשתים במעשה פלא, או כעמק [בגבעון], שהוא בגבעון:


*As in mount Perazim*, known by the wars of David (2 Sam. 5:20); the place was called בעל פרצים place of breaches, because the Philistines were suddenly defeated there in a miraculous way.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:2)


**[ירגז].** שרגז (רמז) בעת עמוד השמש והירח (יהושע י' י"ב), כן יעשה השם מלחמה זרה על ישראל שלא נשמע כמוה:


*As in the valley of Gibeon* (Jos. 10:12), where sun and moon stood still. *That He may do His work, His strange work.* In the same way God will make a strange war against Israel, such as was never heard of before.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:21:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:21:3)


**נכריה עבודתו.** כפול בטעם, כמשפט:


*And bring to pass His act, His strange act.* A mere repetition of the preceding idea, not an exceptional instance.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:22:1)


**ועתה. מוסריכם.** מוסרות:


מוסרותיכם ═ מוסריכם Bands.

**ונחרצה.** גזרה גזורה כמו אתה חרצת (מלכים א' כ' מ'):


ונחרצה *Even determined.* Comp. חרצת thou hast decided (1 Kings 20:40)



### Verse 23

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:23:1)


**האזינו ושמעו קולי.** ושמעו אמרתי, והטעם הקול:


*Hear my voice, hear my speech*. Parallelism.



### Verse 24

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:24:1)


**הכל.** הטעם כי החורש יתקן האדמה פעם אחרי פעם, ויזרע, והארץ מתולדתה תעשה התבואה:


*Doth the plowman,* etc. The plowman tills the ground once and twice, and sows, then the earth by its natural power brings forth the increase.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:24:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:24:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:24:2)


**יפתח וישדד.** יתקן השדה, כמו ישדד לו יעקב (הושע י' י"א), והטעם כפול:


יפתח *He opens,* וישדד *and he breaks the clods,* that is, he prepares the field; comp. Hos. 10:11. יפתח and וישדד are a repetition of the same idea in different words.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:25:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:25:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:25:3)

³² This remark seems to be quite superfluous, especially since חטה did not enlist any such observation from the commentator. The words השעורה ידוע in the Hebrew text, present two other difficulties; firstly, the fem. ידועה is required; secondly, the repetition of שעורה is not the usual style of I. E. The two words contain most probably the explanation of נסמן, and are a corruption of בשעור ידוֹע, in a well-known measure.

### Verse 26

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:26:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:26:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:26:1)


**ויסרו.** והשם כבר יסר הזורע והמפיץ ולמדו איך יעשה:


ויסרו *For the Lord instructed him*.³⁴ The Lord has already instructed him, who sows and scatters the seed, and taught him how to do it.

footnotes:
³⁴ A. V., For his God doth instruct him.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:26:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:26:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:26:2)


וטעם **למשפט** כמו במספרם כמשפט (במדבר כ"ט ל"ב), לעשות כמנהג, וכן אלהיו יורנו:


למשפט *According to the custom*,³⁵ to do as it is usually done; comp. כמשפט after the manner (Num. 29:32). *His God doth teach him.* The same.³⁶

footnotes:
³⁵ A. V., To discretion. I. E. seems to lay stress on the definite article in לַמּשפט according to the usual well-known custom.
³⁶ The same as ויסרו למשפט. I. E. does not explain the change of the tense in the two verbs; the first (וְיִסְּרוֹ) being past, the second (יוֹרֶנּוּ) future; ויסרו could also be explained to be future by the conversive ו, but I. E. paraphrases it כבר יסר, hath already instructed him.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:28:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:28:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:28:3)


**[והמם וגו'].** ועת שיהמם גלגל עגלתו אז פרשיו לא ידוקנו, והטעם כאשר יחרוש לא ידוקנו, כי כל דבר בעתו ברא השם להיותו כן, על כן אחריו גם זאת וגו', הטעם כי לא ידושנו לנצח:


והמם *And he turneth*, etc.³⁷ And when he turns the wheel of his cart to till the field, his horsemen will then not break it (the corn), for God has appointed every thing for its proper season; therefore the prophet continues *This also cometh from the Lord*, namely, that he shall not bruise it always.

footnotes:
³⁷ A. V., Nor break it with a wheel of his cart. I. E. does not refer to this phrase the negation in the beginning of the verse.



### Verse 29

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:29:1)


**הפליא עצה.** פליאה:


הפליא עצה *Who is wonderful in counsel.*


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 28:29:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:29:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/28:29:2)


**תושיה.** חכמה, ויאמר רבי משה הכהן שהוא מגזרת יש, והנה הטעם כי תולדת האדמה והזרעים טובה מתולדתם שישמעו דברי הנביא ולא יועיל, והפך זה יערף כמטר לקחי (דברים ל"ב ב') כאשר פרשתיו:


תושיה הגדיל *Who is great in wisdom*.³⁸ R. Moses Hakkohen derives הושיה from יש substance.³⁹—The nature of the earth and the seeds is better than the character of man, who hears the words of the prophet without any profit The reverse⁴⁰ is expressed by a similar figure: Let my doctrine drop like rain, as I explained (Deut. 32:2)

footnotes:
³⁸ A. V., Excellent in working.
³⁹ Comp. Commentary (assigned to I. E.) on Prov. 2:7: The wisdom is called תושיה, substance, because it is true substance, it is everlasting.
⁴⁰ To listen to the words of the prophet with advantage.



## Chapter 29


### Verse 1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:1)


**הוי אריאל.** יש אומר כי נקראת ירושלם כן על שם המזבח, כמו וההראל, והאריאל (יחזקאל מ"ג ט"ו וט"ז), כי אותיות יהו"א מתחלפות, ויש אומרים שנקראת כן בעבור שמזלה אריה, וזה רחוק:


*Ariel.* Jerusalem. According to some, Ariel is the name of Jerusalem, on account of the altar therein, which is called הראל and also אריאל Harel and Ariel (Ez. 43:15, 16); for the letters אׄ הׄ וׄ יׄ interchange¹; according to others, on account of her planet being the lion; but this is absurd.

footnotes:
¹ Strictly speaking, there is, besides the interchange of א and ה, the omission of י in הראל.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:2)


**קרית.** סמוך ויחסר מלת אמת או הדומה לה:


קרית *The city;* it is in the construct state; supply אמת of truth, or some similar word: the city of truth,


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:3)


**[חנה דוד].** שחנה שם דוד, או כך דרך הלשון לסמוך אל פועל עבר, כמו בראשית (בראשית א' א') תחלת דבר יי (הושע א' ב'):


where David hath dwelt; or the city, where David dwelt, since the whole sentence, with the past tense of a verb, can in this case be considered as a noun in the genitive governed by a preceding substantive; comp. בראשית ברא in the beginning, when God created, etc. (Gen. 1:1); תחלת דבר וגו׳ the beginning of the Lord’s speaking to Hosea (Hos. 1:1).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:4)


**ספו שנה.** הוסיפו שנה, כמו לספות עוד (במדבר ל"ב י"ד):


ספו *Add.* Comp. לספת to add (Num. 32:14).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:5)


ו**חגים** הם העולות:


חגים *Sacrifices.*


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:1:6)


**ינקופו.** פועל עומד, והטעם שיפסקו העולות, או יהיה פועל יוצא ותחסר מלת הנוקפים , כמו ויאמר ליוסף (בראשית מ"ח א'):


ינקפו Will cease. It is a neuter verb. It can also be rendered: they shall kill, ינקפו being explained to be a transitive verb with the omission of the subject (הנקפים the men that kill); comp. ויאמר ליוסף and one said to Joseph² (Gen. 48:1)

footnotes:
² See note on 2:4.



### Verse 2

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:1)


**והציקותי לאריאל.** לירושלם:


*To Ariel.* To Jerusalem.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:2)


**והיתה תאניה.** כמו ואנו הדייגים (ישעיהו י"ט ח'), ויש אומרים מגזרת אנה (בראשית ל"ז ל"ו) שלא ישאר רק מקומה:


תאניה ואניה *Heaviness and sorrow.* Comp. ואנו and they shall mourn (19:8). According to others, A waste place, the two words being derived from אנה where; the meaning of the phrase is, that only her place will be left.³

footnotes:
³ Concerning the use of two different forms of the same word consecutively, see I. E. on 3:1, and note 1.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:2:3)


**והיתה לי כאריאל.** שהמזבח שמם מהעולות, או כאריאל שיזבחו כלם:


והיתה לי כאריאל *And it shall be unto me as Ariel*, as the altar which is desolate of sacrifices,⁴ or like an altar, because the inhabitants will be slaughtered.

footnotes:
⁴ Jerusalem will be similarly desolate of its inhabitants.



### Verse 3

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:3:1)


**וחניתי כדור.** פתאם כמו כדור אל ארץ רחבת ידים (ישעיהו כ"ב י"ח):


כדור *Suddenly*.⁵ Comp. 22:18.⁶

footnotes:
⁵ A. V., Round about.
⁶ It is not clear what I. E. means by comparing this passage with 22:18. כדור in that verse means a ball, a round thing. It would be rather far-fetched to suppose that it meant here as quickly and as suddenly as a ball flying through the air meets us. See c. xxii., note 26.

### Verse 4

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:1)


**ושפלת.** הטעם על דברי שלוחי חזקיהו אל רבשקה:

footnotes:
⁸ Comp. 36:11.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:2)


**מארץ תדברי.** כאילו תדברו מתחתית הארץ:


*Thou shalt speak out of the ground.* Thou shalt speak so, as if the voice came from the depth of the earth.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:4:3)


**כאוב.** כמו וכאובות חדשים (איוב ל"ב י"ט), כי כן אומנותם:


כאב *As a potter*.⁹ Comp. כאבת as bottles.—The potter, because of his vocation,¹⁰ speaks from below.

footnotes:
⁹ A. V., As of one that hath a familiar spirit.
¹⁰ The potter was mostly occupied with his work below the surface of the earth.



### Verse 5

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:5:1)


**והיה כאבק דק.** הוא חסר מלה כי הוא סמוך (ובספר מדוקדק כאבק):


כאבק דק *Like small dust.* Some word must be supplied, because of אבק being in the construct state.¹¹

footnotes:
¹¹ Our editions have כְאָבָק, in the absolute state; I. E. read כַאֲבַק as the dust of, and requires the supplement of a genitive. The translation of the sentence according to I. E. would be, and the multitude of thy strangers shall be small as the dust of.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:5:2)


**המון זריך.** הם מחנה אשור, וזה יהיה לפתע פתאם:


*The multitude of thy strangers.* The army of the Assyrians. *Yet it shall be at an instant, suddenly*. All this, mentioned before, shall take place suddenly.

**[וקול וגו'].** ובקול גדול בסופה וסערה עם להב אש, הטעם על צאת המלאך על מחנה אשור להכחידו:


*With great noise, with storm and tempest, and flame of fire*. All this refers to the angel that was sent to destroy the Assyrian army.



### Verse 7

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:7:1)

צובאיה ═ צוביה Her hosts.¹² ואנשי מצודתה ═ ומצודתה And the men engaged in her siege,¹³ or And all the towers of the besiegers.

¹² A. V., Those that fight against her.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:8:1)

והנה *And behold.* The word חלום dream, is usually followed by והנה and behold, or as if; the subject to the following אׄכֵל is רָעֵב the hungry.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:8:2)

שוקקה Desirous to drink.¹⁴

¹⁴ A. V., Hath appetite.



### Verse 9

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:9:1)


**התמהמהו.** ידבר על [צ"ל אל] אנשי ציון שיתמהו לחפש איך יהיה זה, ומה סוד זאת הנבואה, והנה הנביא ידבר כאשר ידבר איש אל רעהו, ולמה לא ידעו כי הם שכורים ולא מהיין:


*Stay yourselves.* The prophet addresses the men of Zion who will be curious to know how this will happen, and what the meaning of this prophecy is.—The prophet speaks in the same manner as people use to speak one to another; and why do they still not understand him? because *they are drunken, but not with wine.*

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:1)

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:2)

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:10:3)

*For it is sealed.* They cannot understand it; the same meaning is contained in the words, seal the law (8:16),¹⁷ as I explained.

### Verse 12

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:12:1)

*And the book is delivered*, etc. Neither the wise men nor those that have no intellect will understand this prophecy.¹⁸

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:14:1)


**לכן הנני יוסיף.** כמו ונשאר אני (יחזקאל ע' ח') כי אומלל אני (תהלים ו' ג') בעבור שהוא פתוח הלמ"ד, ויש אומרים שמלת יוסיף פועל על משקל תומיך גורלי [שם ט"ז ה']:


הנני יוסיף *Behold I will proceed,* comp. ונשאר אני and I am left (Ez. 9:8); אמלל אני I am withering (Ps. 6:3); אמלל is the third person past, because of the Pathah under ל. Some explain יוסיף to be a participle like תומיך supporting²² (Ps. 16:5).

footnotes:
²² יוסיף is either the third person future of the Hiphil, and strangely joined with the pronoun of the first person, as in the other instances quoted by I.E., or participle Kal of יסף, formed like תּוׄמִי with Hirek instead of Zere in the second syllable.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:14:2)


**הפלא ופלא.** שלא יבינו, על כן אחריו ואבדה, ויש אומר שהוא כמו עושה פלא (שמות ט"ז י"א), ולפי דעתי שעושה פלא כזה:


להפליא את העם הזח הפלא ופלא *To be very embarrassing to this people*,²³ that they shall not understand, that the wisdom of the wise shall be lost, etc. Others explain this phrase thus: To do a marvellous work among this people; comp. עשה פלא who performs wonders (Ex. 15:11). I explain it in the following way: To do to this people a wonderful thing like this.²⁴

footnotes:
²³ A. V., To do a marvellous work among this people.
²⁴ That the wisdom of the wise shall be lost, etc.



### Verse 15

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:15:1

**הוי המעמיקים.** בעומק לבם:


המעמיקים *That seek deep* in the depth of their hearts.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:15:2)


נפתח למ"ד **לסתיר** לחסרון ה"א הבנין כמו לשמיד (ישעיהו כ"ג י"ח):


להסתיר═לסתיר *To hide.* Comp. להשמיד═לשמיד to destroy (23:11)



### Verse 16

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:1)


**הפככם.** והנה הפך האמת:


הפככם You are going from the truth.²⁵

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:2)


**אם כחומר היוצר יחשב.** האדם:


אם כחמר היוצר יחשב Shall man be esteemed as the potter’s clay.²⁶

²⁶ A. V., Shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:16:3)


**ויצר.** מגזרת יוצר אמר בעבור יוצרו לא יבין, והנה הלמ"ד כלמ"ד אמרי לי (בראשית כ' א'):


ויצר *And the thing framed*. It is derived from יצר to form. ליצרו *Of him that framed it.* Comp. לי of me (Gen. 20:13)



### Verse 17

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:17:1)


**הלא מעט.** בימים:


מעט *A little.* A little while, a few days.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:17:2)


**ושב לבנון.** שהוא נותן פרי יותר מהכרמל, ככרמל, והכרמל כיער, וזה הטעם על רעבונם:


*And Lebanon shall be turned*, etc. And the Lebanon, that yields more fruit than Karmel, will become like Karmel, and the latter like a forest; that is to say, they will have scanty food.



### Verse 18

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:18:1)


**ושמעו.** אז יבינו דברי הנבואה, ולא יראו אלה העורים כי אם אחר שיהיו באופל:


*And in that day shall the deaf hear*, etc. Then they will understand the words of the prophecy, and those blind men will not see, until they have already been in darkness.



### Verse 19

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:19:1)


**ויספו.** הצדיקים ימלטו, כי ערי יהודה הבצורות נתפשו כי נכרתו שופטי אחז כאשר פירשתי למעלה (ישעיהו א' כ"ו):


*The meek also shall increase*, etc. The righteous will escape, when the fortified towns of Judah will be taken, and the judges of Ahaz will be no more, as I explained above (1:26).²⁷

footnotes:
²⁷ See c. i. Note 48.



### Verse 20

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:20:1)


**כי אפס.** תם כמו כי אפס כסף (בראשית מ"ז ט"ז):

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:20:2)


**כל שוקדי און.** כמו לשקוד על דלתותי (משלי ח' ל"ד):


שקדי *That watch*. Comp. לשקד to watch (Prov. 8:34)



### Verse 21

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:21:1)


**מחטיאי.** ישמרו דבור אדם ויחטיאוהו כדי להענישו, או יחטיאו אחרים בדבריהם:


מחטיאי אדם בדבר That make a man an offender for a word, that watch the words of man, and accuse him, in order to see him punished; or that cause others to sin by their words.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:21:2)


**יקושון.** מגזרת מוקש (דברים ז' ט"ז), ור' משה הכהן אמר כי הם יוכיחו המוכיח, מגזרת התקוששו וקושו [צפניה ב' א'] ואמר כי היה השי"ן ראוי להדגש:


יקושון *They lay a snare*. Comp. מוקש snare (Deut. 7:16). R. Moses Hakkohen explains יקושון they rebuke, comparing it with התקששו וקשו be rebuked and rebuke (Zeph. 2:1), and says that the ש ought to have a Dagesh.²⁸

footnotes:
²⁸ In the commentary of I. E. on Zeph., R. Moses Hakkohen is quoted to explain התקששו וקשו by התקבצו come together; while the other explanation התווכחו והוכיחו be rebuked and rebuke is given anonymously, as if it were the opinion of I. E. himself.



### Verse 22

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:22:1)


**לכן אשר פדה את אברהם.** והוציאו מבין הרשעים:


*Who redeemed Abraham*, by taking him away from amongst the wicked.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:22:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:22:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:22:2)


**יחוורו.** ילבינו, וזאת הלשון ידועה בארמית:


יחורו *Shall wax pale.* The root חור to be white is frequent in Chaldee.



### Verse 23

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:23:1)


**כי בראותו ילדיו.** והטוב שאני עושה עם הטובים, יקדישו שמי:


*For when he seeth his children*, etc. For when he sees his children, and the good which I shall do to the pious, they—he and his children—shall sanctify my name.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:23:2)


**יעריצו.** ייראו אחרים, או הוא פועל עומד, אחר שהזכיר יעקב אמר על דרך משל כי אילו היה חי ויראה הילדים הטובים והפלא שאעשה עמם, היה הוא עם בניו מקדשים שמי, כי אני הייתי קדוש יעקב:


יעריצו They will cause others to fear the God of Israel, or they shall be afraid, intransitive.²⁹ Having mentioned Jacob, the prophet says metaphorically, they will sanctify, etc. that is to say, if Jacob were alive and saw his pious children, and the wonders which God performed for their sake, he would join his children in sanctifying His name; for He was the holy one of Jacob.

footnotes:
²⁹ פועל עומר is here used in the Hebrew text only to express that the verb is not causative, that it does not mean ייראו אחרים, they will cause others to fear. The expression פועל עומד comprehends more than the term intransitive, and signifies sometimes a transitive verb if contrasted with a causative transitive verb.



### Verse 24

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 29:24:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:24:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/29:24:1)


**וידעו.** ורוגנים, כמו ותרגנו באהליכם (דברים א' כ"ז), והם הפך הלומדים:


ורגנים *And they that murmured*, comp. יתרגנו and you were murmuring (Deut. 1:27). They are the opposite of those that learn doctrine.



## Chapter 30


### Verse 1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:1)


**הוי.** אוי, לבנים הסוררים:


הוי *Woe to*.¹

footnotes:
¹ See c. i. Note 13.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:2)


**ולא מני.** ולא ממני וכן שעו מני (ישעיהו כ"ב ד'):


ממני ═ מני *Of me.* (Comp. 22:4).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:3)


**ולנסוך מסכה.** כמו והמסכה (ישעיהו כ"ה ז'), והטעם משל על העצה:


ולנסוך מסכה *And that cover with a covering.* Comp. והמסכה and the covering (28:20). It is figuratively used for counsel.²

footnotes:
² There is no doubt that מסכה is parallel to עצה and has a similar meaning; but it appears to be a far-fetched explanation, to consider covering as a figure for counsel, simply because counsel is usually given secretly.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:1:4)


**ולא מרוחי.** הטעם מנבואתי:


ולא מרוחי ═ ולא רוחי *But not of my spirit,* that is, of my prophecy.



### Verse 2

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:2:1)


**ההולכים וגו'.** והנה פירש הכתוב למעלה:


*That walk to go down,* etc. This verse explains the preceding.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:2:2)


לא השתנה מ"ם **מעוז** בעבור שהוא מפעל הכפל:


במעוז *In the strength of.* מ retains its vowel, although the word is in the construct state, because of the second and third letter of the root being the same.³ מָעוֹז strength, root מָקוֹם :עזז place, root קום; in the construct state, however, they differ; the former retains the Kamez under מ, the latter changes it into Sheva.

footnotes:
³ Root עזז,—Nouns with a preformative מ, derived from verbs עיע and עיו are alike, e.g.,



### Verse 3

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:3:1)


**והחסות.** שם, והיה ראוי להיות חסות [צ"ל חסיות] על משקל עבדות (עזרא ט' ח'):


והחסות *And the trust.* A noun; it is the contracted form of ⁴חסיות; comp. עבדות slavery (Ezr. 9:8)

⁴ The י in חסיות is substituted for the third radical ה, of נלות ;חסה captivity (Obad. 20) is formed of נלה in a similar manner, with the entire omission of the third radical.



### Verse 4

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:4:1)


**כי. שריו.** הוי"ו שב אל העם שהיו משלחים אפילו שריהם למצרים אולי יושיעו ירושלם מכף מלך אשור:


שריו *His princes.* The princes of the people;⁵ they sent even their princes to Egypt, that the Egyptians might deliver Jerusalem from the Assyrians.

footnotes:
⁵ The substantive עם people, to which the pronominal suffix ־ָיו refers, is not mentioned before, but is implied in בנים סוררים (ver 1.)



### Verse 5

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:5:1)


**כל וגו'.** אל"ף הובאיש נוסף, כל אדם הוביש אלה ההולכים, (פועל יוצא), כי הלכו אל עם לא יוכלו לעזרם:


כל הוביש═כל הבאיש. The א is superfluous; הבאיש is transitive, Every one blamed⁶ those that had gone to Egypt; for they went to a people that would not profit them.

footnotes:
⁶ A. V., They were all ashamed.



### Verse 6

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:1)


**משא בהמות נגב וגו'.** דבקה, על היורדים מצרימה והנה הנביא אומר (על) בהמות נגב, והיא מצרים, כי היא בפאת דרום כנגד ארץ ישראל, ואמר כי בדרך שילכו אלה היורדים יפגעו בהמות קשות כדובים ונמרים, על כן לביא וליש מהם:


*The burden of the beasts of the south.* This refers to those that went down to Egypt. *South.* Egypt, which is in the south of Palestine. The prophet says that, on their way, those messengers would meet wild beasts, as bears, tigers, etc.; this is expressed in the words a lion, a leopard, amongst them an asp, etc.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:2)


**בארץ צרה.** שלא יוכלו לברוח ואלה היורדים ישאו על כתף עירים ממונם, שיברחו בו אל מצרים כמו את החיל הזה (דברים ח' י"ח):


בארץ צרה *In a narrow land*,⁷ whence they will not be able to escape. *They will carry,* etc. Those messengers will carry their property on the back of the mules, in order to bring it to Egypt into safety. חיליהם *Their property.* Comp. החיל the property (Deut. 8:17).

footnotes:
⁷ A. V., Into the land of trouble and anguish.—I. E. takes צרה in a more literal sense, narrow; they will be pressed in, in such a way, that they will not be able to get out again.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:6:3)


**דבשת.** כמו גבנון ואין רע לו, והנה הטעם שבהמות נגב ישחיתו מהם:


דבשת *Bunches.* Hap. leg.—The beasts of the south will do them much damage.



### Verse 7

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:7:1)


**ומצרים.** קראתי לזאת, ירושלם, שינצח מי שישב בה ולא ירד:


לזאת *To this*.⁸ To Jerusalem. רהב הם שבת *Their strength is to sit still.* He who remains in Jerusalem, and will not go down to Egypt, will be strong and safe.

footnotes:
⁸ A. V., Concerning this, that is, concerning Egypt.



### Verse 8

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:8:1)


**עתה בא.** אליהם, כי הנביא היה משתומם משבת אתם:


*Now go.* Now go with them; the prophet has hesitated to be together with them.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:8:2)


**ועל ספר חקה.** כתו' חקה ברפי, ויש ספרי' שהה"א במפיק והנה הו' לשון ציווי, והשלם חוקקה או חוקקה או חקקנה בנו"ן:


חקה *Note it.* חקה is without Dagesh in ה; some copies have the Dagesh; it is the imperative instead of חוקקה or חוקקהּ or חוקקנה.⁹

footnotes:
⁹ It is either the imperative with a paragogic ה, the contracted form of חוׄקקָה or with the pronominal suffix חוׄקְקֶנָּה ═ חוׄקְקָהּ ═ ־ָהּ.



### Verse 9

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:9:1)


**כחשים.** שם התואר על משקל אכרים (ירמיהו י"ד ד') ונקמץ הכ"ף בעבור אות הגרון:

ננוס. According to the grammarian R. Jonah: we shall lift ourselves up; he compares it with נֵס banner (that is lifted up), and gives thus to ננוס a meaning similar to that of נרכב we will ride, as required by the parallelism. אלף *Thousand*. It is in the constr. st. אלף אחד The thousand men of one of you;²² אחד signifies the officer. The meaning of the whole phrase is: An officer over a thousand men will flee at the threatening of one man.

footnotes:
²² The Hebrew text has סמוך אל אחר מהם, which is to be altered into סמוך ,אלף אחד מכם; because אל אחד would be quite superfluous, since there is no other noun that would be the genitive governed by אלף, and I. E., satisfying himself with סמוך or נסמך, leaves it generally to the reader to find the genitive referred to; מהם would refer to the enemies; but it is evident from the whole remark that the first אחד, which refers to the Israelites addressed by the prophet, is to be explained, not the second.

**ביום הרג רב וגו'.** שימותו אנשים בנפל מגדלים, וזאת נחמה, כי אם ימותו עשרה יחיו רבבות, כי בעבור שיפול קיר על האלמנה לא יעצור השם הגשם שלא ישלחנו להחיות רבים, כי אין לגשם דעת שירד על מקום אחד ולא על מקום אחר עמו ביחד:


*In the day of great slaughter*, etc. When people will die through the fall of³⁷ towers. It is a kind of consolation to learn, that when ten die, myriads are kept alive: for although the wall might fall upon the widow through the rain, the Lord will not keep it back from coming down and giving life to many; the rain has no knowledge that it should come down upon one place and not at the same time upon the neighbouring ones.

footnotes:
³⁷ The rain will come in such quantity that the houses and towers will fall and bury under their ruins many people.

Moses Hakkohen is of opinion, that it means to bridle, and that by the breath of God, the false spirit, described by Micaiah (1 Kgs. 22:19—23) is to be understood; and this is the right explanation. *And there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.* The bridle is put in the mouth of the horse, to make it go the right way, but the spirit mentioned here, will be רסן מתעה a misleading bridle. The same idea is expressed by ,בנפת שוא and this proves that להנפה has the meaning to bridle.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:33:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:1)


**כי. מאתמול.** ואם הוא בשורק הוא כמו חולם, וטעם אתמול מלפנים:


מאהמוֹל═מאתמוּל *Of old.*


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:33:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:2)


**תפתה.** שם מקום מטונף סביב ירושלים, ושם ישליכו כל דומן ויעלה ממנו עשן, והטעם כי השם ערך למחנה אשור:


תפתה *Tophet.* The name of a squalid place near Jerusalem, where all refuse was cast, and whence a continual smoke was rising.⁵² The meaning of the sentence is: Tophet is prepared by the Lord for the King of Assyria.

footnotes:
⁵² Tophet is a place in the valley of Ben Hinnom near Jerusalem; Moloch had once been worshipped there, but when that idolatry was abolished it became the receptacle of all the refuse of the city, so that the use thus made of the place formed a striking contrast to the reverence with which it was previously regarded. The horror and disgust felt for this spot was so great that it was considered the greatest curse to be compelled to live in its neighbourhood, and thus it gave its name to the abode of the wicked after death (Gehinnom═hell). It was very probably the smoke rising from the ashes and refuse cast there, that suggested the idea of the eternal fire in hell.

גם הוא למלך הוכן. *Yea, for the king it is prepared.* For all his officers and princes have already perished. According to others the pronoun הוא refers to the King of Assyria.⁵³

footnotes:
⁵³ The translation of the passage accordingly is, Yea, he is appointed King, sc. of Tophet.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:33:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:4)


**מדורתה.** מגזרת מדורה (יחזקאל כ"ד ט') מקום בעור האש:


מדרתה *The pile thereof.* Comp. מדורה fireplace (Ez. 24:9).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 30:33:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/30:33:5)


**נשמת יי.** היוצאה מהרה וזה דרך משל על הגזרות הבאות במהרה:


*The breath of the Lord*, the breath that cometh out quickly; it expresses figuratively the immediate fulfilment of the divine decrees.⁵⁴

footnotes:
⁵⁴ The breath of the Lord is according to I. E. the breath that cometh out of the mouth of the Lord; he therefore paraphrases it, in order to remove the anthropomorphism; but it can also be explained to signify the wind caused by the Lord.



## Chapter 31


### Verse 1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:1)


**הוי.** כמו אוי, ליורדים מצרים שלא ראו זאת התשועה והלכו להנצל, ושם ימותו:


אוי ═ הוי Woe!¹—*Woe unto those that go down to Egypt,* that do not see the deliverance that is coming, and go thither in order to be saved, but will in fact perish there.

footnotes:
¹ See c. i., Note 13.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:1:2)


**ולא שעו.** שלא הרפו עצמם לבטוח בשם, מגזרת שעו מני (ישעיהו כ"ב ד'), והאומר כי שעו חסר נו"ן איננו נכון:


ולא שעו *And they look not.* Lit. They do not resign themselves to the mercy of God.² Comp. שעו מני turn away from me (22:4); to consider שענו ═ שעו is incorrect.³

footnotes:
² שעה means literally to turn away (See I. E. on 17:7, and note 11); it is, therefore, usually followed by מן from; but by way of ellipsis, sometimes by אל, so that שעה מן ⋯ אל ═ שעה אל.
³ שעו is derived from שעה to turn; שענו from שען to lean.



### Verse 2

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:1)


**וגם.** גם השם ידע מחשבותם והביא רע עליהם:


*Yet he also is wise*, etc. God also knew their plans, and has brought evil upon them.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:2:2)


**ואת דברו לא הסיר.** לא בטל:


לא הסיר He hath not called back.⁴

footnotes:
⁴ A.V., He will not call back.



### Verse 3

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:1)


**ומצרים. ולא רוח.** מלאך כמו יי אלהים שלחני ורוחו (ישעיהו מ"ח ט"ז):


*And not a spirit*, that is, not an angel. Comp. ורוחו and His spirit═and His angel (48:16).⁵

footnotes:
⁵ אֵל and רוּחַ are contrasted with אדם and בשר, the help from above with that of man, the deliverance to be caused by God with that expected from the support of Egypt; in the report of the deliverance of Jerusalem from the Assyrian army, the angel is mentioned as the agent; therefore רוח is explained here by angel.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:2)


**ידו.** מכתו:


*His hand.* The striking with His hand.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:3)


**ויחדו.** מצרים והבורחים אליהם, והטעם כי מלך אשור השחית מצרים בבואו אל ירושלם:


*And they all together*, Egypt and those that fled thither. The King of Assyria attacked Egypt at the same time that Jerusalem was threatened by him.⁶

footnotes:
⁶ The expedition of Sennacherib against Egypt was not successful; he besieged Pelusium, but was compelled to retire by Tirhaka, King of Æthiopia. See Geschichte Assure und Babels von Niebuhr, p. 174.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:3:4)


**יכליון.** שלם כמו יחסיון (תהלים ל"ו ח'):


יכליון *They shall fail.* It is the full form, without dropping the third radical, like יחסיון they trust⁷ (Ps. 36:8)

footnotes:
⁷ Comp. 21:12.



### Verse 4

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:1)


**כי.** יהגה, כטעם ישאג:


יהגה *He roareth.* It is the same in meaning as ישאג.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:2)


**אשר יקרא.** זה אל זה להתחבר להלחם עם האריה:


יקרא עליו מלא רעים אשר *When all*⁸ *shepherds are called,* one by the other, to join in the fight against the lion.

footnotes:
⁸ A. V., A multitude of.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:3)


**מלא.** כלם, שלא יחסר רועה שלא יבא:


מלא The full number, all of them, that not one shepherd shall fail to come.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:4)


**ומהמונם לא יענה.** מגזרת עני (דברים כ"ד י"ב) גם לענות (שמות י' ג'), וכמוהו זמיר עריצים יענה (ישעיהו כ"ה ה'):


לא יענה *He will not abase himself.* Root ענה to be poor. Comp. עני poor (Deut. 24:12); לענות to be humble (Ex. 10:3); יענה shall be brought low (25:5).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:4:5)


**ירד.** רמז למלאך:


*So shall the Lord of hosts come down,* etc. The angel coming down to smite the Assyrian army is meant.



### Verse 5

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:1)


**כצפרים.** מלת צפרים נקבה, ואם היא במ"ם כפילגשים לעולם לשון נקבה, על כן עפות:


כצפרים *As birds*. This noun is feminine, although it has the plural termination ־ִים (comp. פילגשים concubines, signifying exclusively a female being, and still with the masculine termination); it is therefore followed by the feminine form עפות flying.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:2)


**עפות.** שם תואר בפועל כמו רצות ושבות (יחזקאל א' י"ד):


עפות is a participle. Comp. רצות ושבוּת running and returning (Ez. 1:14).⁹

footnotes:
⁹ The Hebrew text has רצות נשבות; this seems to be a corruption of רצות ושבות, (the reading of the Br. Mus. MS.); but this phrase is not found in the Bible; we must, therefore, either suggest another reading, perhaps נשמות ארצות, countries that are desolate, (Ez. 30:7), and explain the quotation as a proof of the correctness of the use of the participle as an adjective, or suppose that I. E. read רצות ושבות (Ez. 1:14), instead of רצוא ושוב of our editions.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:3)


**יגן.** יסתיר מגזרת מגן (בראשית ט"ו א'), והטעם על בני הצפרים שיגנו עליהם ויצילום:


יגן *He will cover*.¹⁰ Comp. מגן shield (Gen. 15:1). As the birds cover with their wings their young ones, in order to protect them, so will the Lord, etc.

footnotes:
¹⁰ A.V., Will defend.—Root גנן to cover, to protect.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:4)


**והציל.** שם הפועל אף על פי שהוא בחירק:


וְהִצִּיל *And to deliver*.¹¹ Although there is a Hirek under the ה, it is nevertheless infinitive.¹²

footnotes:
¹¹ A.V., He will deliver.
¹² The regular form is וְהַצֵּל. The same remark is to be applied to וְהִמְלִיט instead of וְהַמְלִיט


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:5:5)


**פסוח.** מגזרת ופסח יי על הפתח (שמות י"ב כ"ג):


פסוח *To pass over*. Comp. ופסח and he will pass over (Ex. 12:23)



### Verse 6

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:6:1)


**שובו.** אלה דברי הנביא שובו לשם אתם בני ישראל שהעמקתם לו סרה, מגזרת סורר (דברים כ"א י"ח):


*Turn ye unto him,* etc. The prophet, addressing Israel, says: Return, ye Israelites, to God, from whom you have deeply revolted. סרה is derived from סרר to revolt. Comp. סורר rebellious (Deut. 21:18)



### Verse 7

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:7:1)


**כי.** ידיכם, רמז לעושים:


*Your hands.* Your workmen.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:7:2)


וטעם **חטא.** שאין חטא למעלה ממנו:


חטא *For a sin;* for a sin *κατ ἐξοχήν,* a sin that surpasses all others.



### Verse 8

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:8:1)


**ונפל.** בחרב לא איש רק ביד המלאך וחרבו השלופה, ואם הוא כדרך משל להבין השומעים:


*With a sword, not of a mighty man*, but with the drawn sword of an angel. The sword is a figurative expression.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:8:2)


**ובחוריו.** הנמלטים ילקחו בדרך:


*And his young men* that will have escaped *shall be discomfited*, shall be overtaken on the ways in which they try to flee.



### Verse 9

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:1)


**וסלעו וגו'.** יעבור סלעו הוא גבול מלכותו, מרוב פחדו, וזה טעם ממגור, והטעם כי יברח ולא ישען על סלעו, [וחתו] מכל נס שיראו שריו הנמלטים או הנשארים בארצו:


*And he shall pass by his stronghold,* etc.¹³ He will go beyond his stronghold at the border of his kingdom, for his great fear; he will flee, and not rely on his strongholds. *And his princes*, etc. His princes that will have escaped, or will remain in the land, will be afraid of every ensign which they will see.

footnotes:
¹³ A. V., And he shall pass over to his stronghold.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 31:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/31:9:2)


**אור ותנור.** רמז למזבח, או דרך משל כאשר הזכיר למעלה ולהב אש אוכלה:


*Fire, furnace*. By these names the altar in Jerusalem is meant; or they are used figuratively,¹⁴ like And the flame of consuming fire (29:6).¹⁵

footnotes:
¹⁴ Signifying the approaching divine punishment.
¹⁵ Comp. I. E., ad locum.



## Chapter 32


### Verse 1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:1:1)

ולשרים *And princes*. The ל has no meaning as far as I know. Comp. לאבשלום (1 Chr. 3:2), למן (Ex. 9:18).¹ Is. 31:1; 1 Sam. 15:22; Deut. 24:5; 1 Chr. 29:6; Ezr. 1:5; Gen. 1:15; or the predicate, *e.g.,* 1 Chr. 1:13; 21:12; 2 Chr. 3:12; 5:12; Jer. 30:12, 15.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:1)

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:2)

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:3)


כציון, מגזרת ציה (מ"א י"ח) כמו חורב:

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:2:4

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:2:5)


[והטעם] **והיה איש.** יהודה כיושב במקום מחבא רוח:

### Verse 3

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:3:1)


**ולא תשעינה.** כמו ועיניו השע (ישעיהו ו' י'):

### Verse 4

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:1)


**ולבב נמהרים.** מגזרת מהירות בכסילות:

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:4:2)

עלגים *The stammerers*. Hap. leg.; in Arabic it means slaves.⁵ It is contrasted with to speak plainly (דבר צחות).

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:4:3

### Verse 5

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:1)


**ולא. נבל.** מגזרת נובלת עליה (ישעיהו א' ל'):


נבל *The vile person.* Comp. נובלת fading⁷ (1:30).

footnotes:
⁷ The oak is said to be fading, on account of its losing its foliage and remaining without fruit and leafless; so נבל the vile person, is without good actions, yielding no benefit to his fellow-men.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:5:2)


**כילי.** הפך שוע ושוע כמו נדיב שידיו רפות לתת ולא סגורות, מגזרת ושוע אל ההר (ישעיהו כ"ב ה'), ויש על דרך דרש שמלת כילי שתים מלות, כי יאמר שלי שלי (אבות ה' י"ג):


כילי The opposite of שוע. שוע *Bountiful.* A noble person, whose hands are loose, ready to give, and not closed. Comp. ושוע and turning.⁸ Adopting a sort of homiletic explanation, כילי may be said to be composed of two words, כי לי for it belongs to me; for he says, שלי שלי what is mine shall remain mine⁹ (Aboth 5:13)

footnotes:
⁸ This quotation is to prove that the two roots שוע and שעה are equivalent in meaning: to loosen, to be or to make ready, to move forward, to turn, to look, to trust. שוע is therefore explained by I. E. to be a person whose hands are loose or open, ready to give whenever opportunity is offered.—Rashi likewise derives שוע from שעה ═ שוע to turn, but in a more simple and natural way; a man to whom the eyes of the people are turned for assistance.
⁹ This is there declared to be מדת סדום the principle of the Sodomites.



### Verse 6

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:1)


**כי נבל.** הטעם על שרי אחז:


*For the vile person,* etc. This refers to the officers of Ahaz.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:6:2)


**תועה.** שם, כי משקלי השמות משתנים:


תועה *Error.* It is a noun; the forms of nouns are manifold.¹⁰

footnotes:
¹⁰ There is hardly any occasion for this remark. We find, except תעתועים errors (Jer. 10:5), no other noun of this root in the Bible; in the post-biblical literature, however, we meet with טעות and תעות error.



### Verse 7

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:7:1)


**וכילי כליו.** הטעם כלי המשפט כי היו [השרים] דינים, והנה אומנותם לעות הדין:


*The instruments also*, etc. The instruments of justice; for the officers were judges, whose principle was to arrest judgment.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:8:1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:9:1

**נשים וגו'.** יש אומרים כי בנות הטעם הקריות כי הם חשובות כבנות ושומרון היתה כאם:


*Ye daughters.* According to some the towns, which are like the daughters of the metropolis Samaria.



### Verse 10

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:1)


**ימים.** הטעם שנה על שנה:


שנה על שנה ═ ימים על שנה. Year after year.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:2)


**רגזה.** בחסרון נו"ן, והנגיד אומר שהוא לשון ציווי, ואם הוא על לשון זכר, ורבי משה הכהן אמר שהוא שם הפעל:


רגזה¹¹=רגזנה *Be troubled.* The opinion of the Nagid¹² is, that רגזה is imperative, referring to the feminine בטחות, although it has a masculine termination; according to R. Moses Hakkohen it is infinitive.

footnotes:
¹¹ I. E. seems to have read רגזה (as in the next verse), instead of תרגזנה; for רגזה is mentioned again by him, and instead of commenting on it, he refers to the explanation given before; it is therefore impossible to suggest that this remark on רגזה has been dislocated from its proper place by the carelessness of some copyist.
¹² R. Samuel, the Prince, several times mentioned by I. E. See Introd. to Moznaim, and Zahoth, On the secondary conjugations.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:10:3)


**אוסף [בלי יבוא].** הטעם כפול, אוסף התבואה:


*The gathering* of the increase *shall not come*. Repetition of the same idea.¹³

footnotes:
¹³ As contained in the words, the vintage shall fail.



### Verse 11

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:1)


**חרדו.** על לשון זכר כמו אם תעירו (שיר השירים ב' ז') אם תמצאו [שם ה' ח'], בדרך קצרה:


חרדו *Tremble.* Imperative masculine. Comp. תעירו ye stir (Song 2:7); תמצאו ye find (Ib. 5:8). It may be considered as an elliptical expression.¹⁴

footnotes:
¹⁴ The use of the imperative plural masculine instead of the feminine is called by I. E. דרך קצרה ellipsis, since the feminine requires the addition of two letters נָה the masculine only וּ; but the use of the termination ־ִים instead of the feminine וֹת (next verse), is explained by supplying the word כׂל all, which is masculine singular in form, but plural in meaning.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:11:2)


**רגזה.** זכרתיו, וככה משפט פשוט' ועורה שיפשטו הבגדים, ועורה מגזרת ערום ועריה (יחזקאל ט"ז ז') עריה תעור (חבקוק ג' ט'), והנכון בעיני כי הנשים הם כמשמעם:


רגזה I have explained this word already. פשוטה וערה *Strip you and make you bare.* These words are to be explained in the same way.¹⁵ וערה *And make you bare.* Comp. עריה naked (Ez. 16:7). עריה תעור Thy bow will be made quite naked (Hab. 3:9). I think that women, daughters (ver. 9), are to be taken literally.

footnotes:
¹⁵ As רגזה has been explained, namely as imperatives or infinitives.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:12:1)


**על שדים סופדים.** כל הנשים, תחס' מלת כל, כמו וכל הנשים יתנו יקר (אסתר א' כ'):


סופדים *They shall lament.* כל all is to be supplied.¹⁴ Comp. וכל הנשים יתנו and all women shall give. (Est. 1:20)

E. דרך קצרה ellipsis, since the feminine requires the addition of two letters נָה the masculine only וּ; but the use of the termination ־ִים instead of the feminine וֹת (next verse), is explained by supplying the word כׂל all, which is masculine singular in form, but plural in meaning.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:14:1)


**כי ארמון.** המלך עזב גם נטש מהבנין הקל [צ"ל הכבד] שלא נקרא שם פועלו:


*The palace* of the king. נטש, *shall be forsaken*; עזב, *shall be left.* Pual.¹⁶

footnotes:
¹⁶ Instead of מהבנין הקל שלא וגו׳ is to be read נֻטָּשׁ .מהבנין הכבד שׁלא וגו׳ and עֻזָּב are participles of the Pual, the prefix מ having been dropped. See Zahoth, On the secondary conjugations (בנינים הנלקחים מאחרים). I. E. rejects the opinion of R. Moses Hakkohen, who says that forms like לֻקַּח are sometimes derived from the Kal, namely, when the Piel of that verb is not found in Scripture.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:14:3

ובחן *And tower.* Comp. בחוניו his towers. (23:13). היו מערות═ היה בעד מערות shall become dens.



### Verse 15

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:1)


**עד יערה.** מבנין נפעל, והטעם כי אלינו תביט הרעה, על ביאת מלך אשור אל ארץ יהודה, והטעם גזירה:


יערה *Be poured.* Niphal. עד יערה עלינו רוח Until the decreed evil, the approach of the King of Assyria to the land of Judah, be poured upon us. רוח signifies here the divine decree.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:15:2)


**והיה.** כל מדבר זרוע כמו הכרמל, והכרמל ליער יחשב כחבירו הראשון:


*And the plain*¹⁹, that is cultivated, will be *like Karmel*,²⁰ *and Karmel,* etc. Comp. 29:17

footnotes:
¹⁹ A. V., Wilderness.—According to I. E., מדבר signifies here a plain, used for a corn-field; in the similar phrase (29:17), it is replaced by Lebanon, which is said to be more fruitful than Karmel, in the same measure as Karmel is superior to the forest (יער). The original meaning of מדבר is in fact pasture, whither the flock is driven (דבר to drive). See Gesen. Lex. Hebr.
²⁰ A. V., Fruitful field.

**וישב.** איש יהודה:

### Verse 19

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:1)


**וברד.** הרי"ש פתוח כי הוא פעל כמו עשן כולו (שמות י"ט י"ח) והטעם כי אם ירד ברד אל היער ירד ולא אל מקום הזרע:


וברד *When it shall hail.* The Pathah under ר proves that the word is a verb; comp. עשן it smoked (Ex. 19:18). *When it shall hail, coming down on the forest.* When the hailstones will come down, they will come down on the forest, not on the fields.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 32:19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/32:19:2)


וטעם **תשפל העיר** שתשב פרזות כבקעה:


*The city shall be low*, shall be like a wide plain without walls²³

footnotes:
²³ In time of war the people used to retire to the mountains, where they lived in forts and fortresses, and were thus enabled to resist the attack of the invading army; but as soon as the danger was over the people scattered again over the valleys and plains, to live in villages and open towns, where they could with greater ease devote themselves to their usual pursuits.

שוקק *Gathering*.⁵⁵ Some think that משק the steward (Gen. 15:2) is of the same root. I compare it rather with ישתקשקון they gather themselves (Nah. 2:5), which expression is likewise used of locusts.

### Verse 7

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:7:1

**הן אראלם.** יש אומרים מגזרת אריאל כאילו אמר על אראלם, ואיננו נכון בטעם הפרשה, ויש אומרים שהן שתי מלות, אראה להם, גם זה רחוק, והנכון בעיני, שמלת אראלם כמו מלאכיהם והעד מלאכי שלום, וכמוהו את שני אריאל מואב (שמואל ב' כ"ג כ') והטעם כי מלאכי כל גוי שיבקשו שלום בעולם יבכו בשלוט מלכות אשור:


אראלם According to some their altar; comp. אריאל (29:1); if this were correct, we should have to supply על for, but this explanation is not in accord with the whole context of the chapter. Others say, that אראה להם ═ אראלם I shall see them; this is not probable. I think that it means their messenger, as we may infer from the ambassadors of peace in the second half of the verse. Comp. 2 Sam. 23:20.⁸—All the messengers of the nations, that are desirous of peace, will weep when Assyria has dominion.

**אבל.** ימצא ארץ לשון זכר כמו נעתם ארץ (ישעיהו ט' י"ח), והנה זה הפסוק מכחיש דברי רבי משה הכהן שאמר כי תאכלהו אש לא נפח (איוב כ' כ"ו) כן דרך הלשון כל מלה שהיא לזכר ולנקבה לא יתכן לומר לשון נקבה אחרי לשון זכר:


אבל אמללה ארץ *The earth mourneth and languisheth.* ארץ is sometimes used as a masculine noun; comp. 9:18. This phrase⁹ overthrows the rule laid down by R. Moses Hakkohen (Job 20:26), that words which can be used both as masculine and feminine nouns, cannot be joined with a feminine attribute, after having been joined with a masculine one in the same phrase.

*The sinners in Zion are afraid*. They will be afraid of the Lord, when they see His power displayed in the destruction of the Assyrian army; then will they say: *Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire,* with the Lord, who is like the devouring fire, that is, in Zion, where the divine glory manifests itself. ### Verse 17

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:17:1)


**מלך וגו'.** אלה דברי הנביא, כאומר יזכור יהודה בבא מלאכי מלך אשור לקחת מס מחזקיהו, כי כל אוצרות בית השם נתן, והעניש כל יהודה, והיו אומר מי ילך עמנו משרי חזקיה אל מלך אשור במס זה, הוא מלך ביופיו תחזינה עיניך תראינה ארץ מרחקים כי אשור רחוק' מירוש':


*Thine eyes shall see the king,* etc. The prophet brings these words back to the memory of Judah;¹⁷ הסופר the secretary, that wrote down how much each had to contribute, and who was to carry the tribute to the king of Assyria; comp. ver. 18 and 22. The words of this verse were, as distinctly stated by I. E., addressed to Judah by the Assyrian officers. when the messengers of the king of Assyria came for the tribute, and Hezekiah, after having delivered up all the treasures of the temple, imposed besides a tax on Judah for that purpose, they said, who of the princes of Hezekiah will come with us, to bring this tribute to the king of Assyria? thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty; they shall behold the land that is far off, the land of Assyria, that is far from Jerusalem.

footnotes:
¹⁷ The Hebrew text has the words אלה דברי הנביא כאומר יזכור יהודה lit., These are the words of the prophet, as if he said, that Judah should remember. The remark of I. E. on ver. 15 begins likewise with the phrase אלה דברי הנביא these are the words of the prophet. This introduction is there an essential part of the explanation, since part of the preceding verse was assigned to the people; but this verse does not require an introduction of this kind. A comparison of this remark with ידבר בנפשו (ver. 18) leads to the suggestion, that instead of הנביא another word, signifying the messenger, or the officer, is to be read, as, e.g.,

footnotes:
²² The combination of the singular יסע and the plural יתדותיו is explained in this remark, by considering יתד מיתדותיו ═ יתדותיו. See c. ii., note 18.



### Verse 21

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:1)


**כי וגו'.** נטעם לא יסע זה האהל, רק יהיה השם אדיר לנו, במדינה שיש סביבותיה נהרים:


*But there*, etc. This tent shall not be removed, but God will be there unto us as a stronghold, like a place surrounded by rivers.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:2)


**יאורים.** חסר וי"ו כמו שמש ירח עמד (חבקוק י' י"א):


נהרים יארים *Rivers, streams.* Asyndeton; comp. שמש ירח sun, moon (Hab. 3:11).


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:21:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:21:3)


**ידים.** מקומות, והטעם מכל פאה, והם נהרים שלא ילך באחד מהם אני במשוט והטעם שלא יפחדו מאויב לא מהים ולא מהיבשה:


ידים Space.²³ *A place of broad rivers*.²⁴ A place surrounded on all sides by rivers, בל תלך בו וגו׳ *wherein shall go no,* etc.²⁵ None of the rivers will be passed by any ships with oars; the people will have no cause for fear, either from the sea or from the continent. Thus this verse contrasts with the words Thine heart meditates terror (ver. 18)

footnotes:
²³ רחבי ידים Wide of space, that is, spacious, or broad.
²⁴ I. E. explains why the plural rivers is used here.
²⁵ The incongruity of the singular בו with the plural יארים, to which it refers, is explained in the usual way. See c. ii., note 18.



### Verse 22

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:22:1)


**כי וגו'.** זה הפסוק כנגד לבך יהגה אימה, ואין מי שישפוט עוד שיאמר פלני יתן מס זה, והמחוקק הוא הסופר יכתוב מי ומי ילך אל המלך במס כי השם לבדו הוא שפטנו ומחוקקנו ומלכנו:


*For the Lord is our judge,* etc. There will be no judge to say to this person and that pay so and so much for the tribute, nor will any scribe write down, who shall go to the king with the tribute; for the Lord alone will be our judge, our scribe,²⁶ and our king.

footnotes:
²⁶ A. V., Lawgiver.



### Verse 23

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:1)


**נטשו.** כ"ף חבליך לנכח מחנה אשור:


*Thy tacklings.* The Assyrian army is adressed.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:2)


**נטשו** כמו ונטשתה (שמות כ"ג י"א), דרך משל כי הספינה תטבע והים ישליך הממון שיש בה:


נטשו *Are loosed.* Comp. ונמשתה thou shalt let it lie still²⁷ (Ex. 23:11). The meaning of this figure is: the ship will go down, and her riches will then be thrown out again by the sea.

footnotes:
²⁷ Lit., And thou shalt let loose of it; that is, thou shalt not take hold of it, to till it, and to do the usual work therein.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:23:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:3)


**בל.** יחזקו החובלים התורן שלהן, ולא יפרשו נס, אז יחלק עד שלל, כמו אדמת עפר (דניאל י"ב ב') מגזרת בבקר יאכל עד (בראשית מ"ט כ"ז):


תרנם וגו׳ בל יחזקו כן They, that is, the sailors, cannot strengthen their mast, nor spread the sail.²⁸ עד שלל *The prey of a spoil.* Comp. אדמת עפר the dust of the earth (Dan. 12:2).²⁹ עד *Spoil.* Comp. Gen. 49:27.

footnotes:
²⁸ A. V., They could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail.
²⁹ See c. xxx., note 18.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:23:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/33:23:4)


**מרבה.** כמו הרבה איספו פסחים בזזו בז ואף כי אחרים:


הרבה ═ מרבה Great. *The lame shall take prey*. How much more the others.

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 33:24:1

## Chapter 34


### Verse 1

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 34:1:1

**קרבו. ומלואה.** שהיא מלאה מהם:


ומלאה *And its fulness*;¹ that is, those beings of which it is full.

¹ A. V., And all that is therein.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 34:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:1:2)


**תבל.** מקום הישוב:


תבל The inhabited part of the earth.²

² A. V., The world. According to I. E., ארץ is the whole earth; תבל the inhabited part of it.


###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 34:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:1:3)


**וכל צאצאיה.** מגזרת יצא:


צאצאיה The things that come out of it. It is derived from יצא to go out.



### Verse 2

###### Ibn Ezra on Isaiah 34:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ibn%20Ezra%20on%20Isaiah/r/34:2:1)


**כי וגו'.** כל המפרשים אומרים כי זה לעתיד, רק רבי משה הכהן אומר כי אדום חרבה בימי אשור וכל הפרשה הי' דבקה:


*For the indignation*, etc. All commentators refer this prophecy to the Messianic period, except R. Moses Hakkohen, who says, that Edom was destroyed in the time of the invasion by the Assyrians, and that all these chapters (xxiv—xxxiv) are connected with each other.³

footnotes:
³ Although it is not distinctly mentioned, it may be fairly supposed that Edom was conquered by the Assyrians at the same time when Syria and all the neighbouring countries were occupied by the armies of Assyria.—Edom was conquered and united with Judæa by John Hyrcanus, 129 B.C.
